title: Pavane pour une infante défunte
video_use_ideas: A formal farewell or a black-tie still.
legal_notes: Piano pavane published 1899; orchestration 1910. Ravel d.1937: PD in life+70 countries since 2008, and PD-US because of the 1899 publication. This audio is not a concert performance. The file page says the uploader created it with a GigaSampler virtual piano and released it with PD-self: the copyright holder releases the work into the public domain worldwide, or if that is not possible grants use for any purpose without conditions. Boléro was not included (disputed). No clean PD edition of the String Quartet, movement 2, was found.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
